title: Motion & CSS craft
summary: Curves, transitions and small details that make an interface feel made, all collapsing under reduced motion.

components.name: Motion tokens & curves
components.summary: Side-by-side ease-out, spring and in-out at 90–320ms, the only curves this kit uses.

anatomy.name: Spring
anatomy.text: Small indicators only: thumbs, pills, checks.

components.prompt: Use motion tokens only: --dur-1 (90ms) to --dur-3 (200ms) for controls, --dur-4 (320ms) for sheets and drawers, --ease-out for entrances, --ease-in-out for swaps, --ease-spring for small indicators. All durations collapse to 1ms under prefers-reduced-motion.
components.debug: Debug my motion. Rule out: hard-coded durations that ignore reduced motion; ease-in on entrances; spring overshoot on large surfaces; transitions over 300ms on small controls. The symptom:

components.name: View Transition helper
components.summary: Morph elements between layouts with the View Transitions API and a no-op fallback.
called: smooth morph between grid and list

anatomy.name: Named element
anatomy.text: Each moving element needs a unique name.

components.prompt: Animate layout changes with the View Transitions API: give moving elements unique view-transition-name values, wrap the DOM update in document.startViewTransition, and skip it under reduced motion or when unsupported.
components.debug: Debug my view transition. Rule out: duplicate view-transition-name values (the transition is skipped); React updates not flushed inside the callback (flushSync); transitions running under reduced motion. The symptom:

components.name: Scroll reveal
components.summary: Sections fade up once as they enter view, with no scroll-jacking.
called: fade in when you scroll down

anatomy.name: Revealed section
anatomy.text: Fades up 12px once, then stays put.

components.prompt: Add a one-time scroll reveal: sections fade up 12px the first time they enter the viewport (IntersectionObserver, 15% threshold), hidden only after the script arms them so content is never lost, and visible immediately under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my scroll reveal. Rule out: content hidden in CSS before JS runs; elements re-animating every time; reveals that never fire near the bottom of the page. The symptom:

components.name: Cursor-follow spotlight
components.summary: A soft single-hue glow and border light that follow the pointer across a card.
called: glow that follows the mouse on a card

anatomy.name: Card
anatomy.text: A single-hue glow and a lit border edge.

components.prompt: Add a cursor spotlight: on pointermove (mouse only) set --mx/--my on the card; draw a soft radial gradient of --accent-soft at that point and a masked border highlight; fade out on leave; off under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my spotlight. Rule out: multi-colour gradients; effects on touch; the glow covering text contrast. The symptom:

components.name: Optical icon alignment
components.summary: Icons centred on cap height, play triangles nudged, trailing arrows tightened.

anatomy.name: Play triangle
anatomy.text: Nudged right because its weight sits left.

components.prompt: Align icons optically: inline-flex with align-items: center, icons sized in em, play triangles nudged 1px right, trailing arrows with a smaller gap than leading icons.
components.debug: Debug my icon alignment. Rule out: icons as inline images on the text baseline; fixed pixel icons in scaling text; play icons centred geometrically. The symptom:

components.name: Tactile press
components.summary: Press-down scale on :active with a spring release, for any clickable surface.
called: button that shrinks a bit when pressed

anatomy.name: Pressable
anatomy.text: Down fast with ease-out, back with a spring.

components.prompt: Add tactile press feedback: on :active scale to --press-scale (0.97) in 90ms ease-out, release on a spring; 1 under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my press effect. Rule out: scale on disabled controls; long transitions that feel laggy; scale on large surfaces. The symptom:

components.name: Staggered entrance
components.summary: List items enter 40ms apart, capped so long lists never drag.

anatomy.name: Item
anatomy.text: Delay grows 40ms per item, capped at six.

components.prompt: Stagger list entrances: each item fades up with animation-delay calc(min(var(--i), 6) * 40ms) so long lists never drag; none under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my stagger. Rule out: uncapped delays making long lists slow; stagger replaying on every re-render; animations under reduced motion. The symptom:

components.name: Text shimmer
components.summary: Loading text with a soft light sweeping across it; still under reduced motion.
called: text with light moving across it while loading

anatomy.name: Shimmer text
anatomy.text: Muted text with a primary-ink highlight passing through.

components.prompt: Add a text shimmer for in-progress states: muted text with a linear-gradient highlight in primary ink clipped to the text, sweeping left to right every 2.2s, role="status" so the words are announced, and plain muted text under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my text shimmer. Rule out: the gradient colours hard-coded so it vanishes in dark mode; -webkit-text-fill-color missing in Safari; animation left running under reduced motion; shimmer on text people need to read carefully. The symptom:

components.name: Typewriter words
components.summary: A headline whose last word types, pauses and deletes itself to cycle through options.
called: headline where one word keeps changing

anatomy.name: Rotating word
anatomy.text: Accent ink; the sentence stays readable around it.

anatomy.name: Caret
anatomy.text: Blinks only while waiting, solid while typing.

components.prompt: Add a typewriter headline: a fixed prefix and a last word that deletes at 38ms per letter, types at about 90ms, holds for 2s, then moves to the next word. Hide the moving text from screen readers and give them the full sentence once; pause on hover, focus and hidden tabs; swap words without typing under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my typewriter. Rule out: screen readers announcing every letter (aria-hidden on the animated text); layout shift as the word changes width (put it at the end of the line); timers running in background tabs; no reduced-motion path. The symptom:

components.name: Logo marquee
components.summary: An endless, edge-faded strip of customer wordmarks that pauses on hover.
called: row of company logos that scrolls forever

anatomy.name: Wordmark
anatomy.text: Muted ink so logos do not compete with the page.

anatomy.name: Faded edges
anatomy.text: Logos fade in and out instead of being cut.

anatomy.name: Duplicate row
anatomy.text: Lets the loop join without a jump; hidden from screen readers.

components.prompt: Add a logo marquee under the hero: a muted "Trusted by teams at" line, then two identical rows of wordmarks (the second aria-hidden) translating -100% over 32s linear infinite, edges faded with mask-image, paused on hover and focus, and a static centred wrap under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my marquee. Rule out: a jump at the loop point (rows must be identical with equal padding); screen readers reading every logo twice; colourful logos fighting the hero; animation under reduced motion. The symptom:

components.name: Text reveal
components.summary: The words of one headline rise in one after another, once, when it first comes on screen.
called: headline where the words appear one at a time
the text that slides up word by word

anatomy.name: Headline
anatomy.text: Real text in the markup. The script wraps each word; nothing depends on it.

components.prompt: Add a text reveal to one headline per page: on first view, split its text into word spans (keep inline elements) and let each rise 0.4em and fade in over 520ms with an ease-out curve, 45ms after the word before it. Use opacity and translate only. Run once, never on scroll back. With reduced motion or no script the headline is plain text. Never use it on body copy, on more than one heading per screen, or letter by letter.
components.debug: Debug my text reveal. Rule out: text invisible when script fails (hide words only after splitting); layout shift from words changing size; replaying on every scroll; letter-by-letter splitting that breaks screen readers and ligatures; more than one revealed heading on a screen; a blur filter that smears on low-end devices.
